record.question: Which one of the following is the apex bank for agricultural credit in India?
record.explanation: Answer C: NABARD. NABARD is India’s apex development bank for agriculture and rural development. Reference: https://www.nabard.org/content.aspx?id=2. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
